batches_cost_has_rate.name: batches_cost_has_rate
batches_cost_has_rate.value: actual_cost_fen IS NULL OR actual_cost_fx_rate IS NOT NULL

categories_parcel_nonneg.name: categories_parcel_nonneg
categories_parcel_nonneg.value: default_weight_g >= 0 AND default_length_mm >= 0 AND default_width_mm >= 0 AND default_height_mm >= 0

ledger_fen_has_rate.name: ledger_fen_has_rate
ledger_fen_has_rate.value: source_amount_fen IS NULL OR fx_rate IS NOT NULL

orders_link_or_condition.name: orders_link_or_condition
orders_link_or_condition.value: product_url IS NOT NULL OR condition_preference IS NOT NULL OR path_type = 'digital'

orders_no_batch_for_direct.name: orders_no_batch_for_direct
orders_no_batch_for_direct.value: batch_id IS NULL OR shipping_mode IN ('air','air_sensitive','sea')

payments_manual_has_proof.name: payments_manual_has_proof
payments_manual_has_proof.value: method <> 'duitnow_manual' OR proof_photo_key IS NOT NULL

quotes_amounts_nonneg.name: quotes_amounts_nonneg
quotes_amounts_nonneg.value: item_price_fen >= 0 AND item_price_sen >= 0 AND service_fee_sen >= 0 AND shipping_estimate_min_sen >= 0 AND delivery_fee_sen >= 0 AND fee_credit_sen >= 0 AND total_min_sen >= 0
